title: The Suitable place for the garden
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：suitable　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 suitable 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the nurse wrote of ① a suitable place for the garden in the report, and everybody in the ward said at once that it was ② so suitable that nobody in the ward would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the nurse, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the suitable ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the suitable place for the garden that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report for April 1969 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too suitable to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the sufferer who had come to help; the suitable ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the thermometer at the far cupboard, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a suitable moment for the talk, and said that no sufferer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as suitable as the moment for the talk they had once had in the old ward. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was suitable or not, and he said so.

By 1982 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was ⑦ something suitable, and nothing besides. The sufferer from the next ward called the whole plan ⑧ quite suitable; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the report kept the names of the suitable ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1985, in the rain, she wrote of another suitable place for the garden in the same report, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less suitable than anybody had expected. ⑩ The suitable moment for the talk that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1987, was the one she could never quite name; the suitable ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 合适（前置定语 a suitable place for the garden：1975 年护士在护理记录里记下的那件合适的地点）
B. adj. 合适／适宜（两处加强说法：so suitable that … 与 no less suitable than …）
C. adj. 合适／适宜（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 合适（表语 too suitable to do：母亲觉得它太合适，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 适宜（前置定语 a suitable moment for the talk：叔叔把整件事称作一桩适宜的时机）
F. adj. 适宜（同级比较 as suitable as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩谈话的适宜时机相比）
G. adj. 适宜（后置定语 something suitable：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 适宜（受程度副词修饰 quite suitable：那位病患的评价）

items.q: a suitable place for the garden
the suitable place for the garden that
a suitable moment for the talk
The suitable moment for the talk that

answers.why: suitable 意为“合适”，1975 年护士在护理记录里记下的是“一件合适的地点”，此处作前置定语 a suitable place for the garden。
suitable 意为“合适”，此处用 so suitable that 结构，说它合适到病房里没人敢靠近。
suitable 意为“合适”，护理记录上 四月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的合适种园子的合适地点，等于最高级的说法。
suitable 意为“合适”，母亲认为这件东西“太合适了，谁也用不上”，too suitable to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
suitable 意为“适宜”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩适宜的时机”，此处作前置定语 a suitable moment for the talk。
suitable 意为“适宜”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩谈话的适宜时机一样适宜”，同级比较用 as suitable as。
suitable 意为“适宜”，护理记录上那半行字要的是“适宜的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something suitable。
suitable 意为“适宜”，邻病房来的那位病患认为这套计划“相当适宜”，quite 修饰原级 suitable。
suitable 意为“适宜”，no less suitable than 表示“其适宜不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之适宜不亚于任何人的预料。
suitable 意为“适宜”，母亲 1987 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的适宜时机”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1975 年，护士在护理记录里记下了一件合适的地点。（a suitable place for the garden）
它合适到病房里没有一个人敢靠近。（so suitable that …）
母亲觉得它太合适，谁也用不上。（too suitable to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩适宜的时机。（a suitable moment for the talk）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩谈话的适宜时机一样适宜。（as suitable as …）
到了 1982 年，护理记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件适宜的东西。（something suitable）
answers: In 1975 the nurse wrote of a suitable place for the garden in the report.
It was so suitable that nobody in the ward would go near it.
My mother thought it too suitable to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a suitable moment for the talk.
He said nobody would call it as suitable as the moment for the talk they had once had.
By 1982 the report asked for nothing but something suitable.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 suitable 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the nurse wrote of a suitable place for the garden in the report, and nobody forgot it.
It was the suitable place for the garden that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report says.
My mother thought it too suitable to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a suitable moment for the talk, and nobody argued with him.
The sufferer from the next ward called the plan quite suitable, and everybody laughed.
The suitable ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
